```{r setup}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(ggiraph)
library(crosstalk)

data_dir <- "data/IDOT_crashes"
cache_file <- "data/idot_evanston_crashes.rds"

files <- sort(list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "\\.geojson$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
))

if (length(files) == 0L) {
  stop("No GeoJSON files found in: ", data_dir)
}

boundary_file <- "data/evanston_boundary.geojson"

if (!file.exists(boundary_file)) {
  stop("Missing Evanston boundary file: ", boundary_file)
}

evanston_boundary <- st_read(boundary_file, quiet = TRUE)

if (is.na(st_crs(evanston_boundary))) {
  stop("The Evanston boundary has no coordinate reference system.")
}

evanston_boundary <- evanston_boundary |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(4326)

boundary_geometry <- st_union(st_geometry(evanston_boundary))

if (
  length(boundary_geometry) == 0L ||
  any(st_is_empty(boundary_geometry)) ||
  !all(st_geometry_type(boundary_geometry) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON"))
) {
  stop("The Evanston boundary must contain nonempty polygon geometry.")
}

# Track both crash files and the boundary so either change rebuilds the cache.
tracked_files <- c(files, boundary_file)
file_info <- file.info(tracked_files)

source_manifest <- tibble(
  file = normalizePath(tracked_files),
  size = file_info$size,
  modified = as.numeric(file_info$mtime)
)

# Increment this version if the processing rules below change.
cache_version <- 4L

cached <- if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  NULL
}

cache_is_current <- is.list(cached) &&
  identical(cached$version, cache_version) &&
  identical(cached$sources, source_manifest)

injury_levels <- c(
  "No Apparent Injury",
  "Possible Injury",
  "Suspected Minor Injury",
  "Suspected Serious Injury",
  "Fatal Injury",
  "Unknown"
)

if (cache_is_current) {
  evanston_crashes <- cached$data
} else {
  # Select only common fields needed for this analysis.
  required_fields <- c(
    "CrashID",
    "CityName",
    "CrashYr",
    "CrashMonth",
    "CrashDay",
    "TypeOfFirstCrash",
    "TotalFatals",
    "TotalInjured",
    "AInjuries",
    "BInjuries",
    "CInjuries"
  )

  numeric_fields <- c(
    "CrashYr",
    "CrashMonth",
    "CrashDay",
    "TotalFatals",
    "TotalInjured",
    "AInjuries",
    "BInjuries",
    "CInjuries"
  )

  read_evanston_crashes <- function(file) {
    message("Reading ", basename(file))

    crashes <- st_read(file, quiet = TRUE)

    # Normalize the year column used by the 2025 schema.
    # Keep CrashYr as the common name for downstream processing.
    if (!"CrashYr" %in% names(crashes) &&
        "CrashYear" %in% names(crashes)) {
      crashes <- crashes |>
        rename(CrashYr = CrashYear)
    }
    
    missing_fields <- setdiff(required_fields, names(crashes))

    if (length(missing_fields) > 0L) {
      stop(
        basename(file),
        " is missing required fields: ",
        paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    if (is.na(st_crs(crashes))) {
      stop("Missing coordinate reference system in: ", basename(file))
    }

    # Select the common attributes and use the supplied GIS geometry.
    crashes <- crashes |>
      select(all_of(required_fields)) |>
      mutate(
        CrashID = as.character(CrashID),
        across(all_of(numeric_fields), as.numeric),
        source_file = basename(file)
      ) |>
      st_transform(4326)

    # Normalize two-digit source years, such as 14, to four digits.
    # These source files cover years in the 2000s.
    crashes <- crashes |>
      mutate(
        CrashYr = as.integer(if_else(
          between(CrashYr, 0, 99),
          CrashYr + 2000,
          CrashYr
        ))
      )

    if (anyNA(crashes$CrashYr) ||
        any(!between(crashes$CrashYr, 2000, 2099))) {
      stop("Missing or unexpected crash years in: ", basename(file))
    }

    # Use location rather than the reported municipality.
    # Empty geometries and points outside Evanston are excluded.
    inside_evanston <- lengths(
      st_intersects(crashes, boundary_geometry)
    ) > 0L

    crashes[inside_evanston, ]
  }


  annual_crashes <- lapply(files, read_evanston_crashes)
  crashes_raw <- bind_rows(annual_crashes)

  if (nrow(crashes_raw) == 0L) {
    stop("No crash locations intersect the Evanston boundary.")
  }

  # Save the reported crash-type distribution for auditing the selection.
  crash_type_audit <- crashes_raw |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    count(TypeOfFirstCrash, sort = TRUE)

  write_csv(
    crash_type_audit,
    file.path(data_dir, "evanston_crash_type_audit.csv")
  )

  crashes_prepared <- crashes_raw |>
    mutate(
      # Replace terminology using descriptive labels, not assumed numeric codes.
      crash_type_text = str_to_upper(str_squish(TypeOfFirstCrash)),
      collision_mode = case_when(
        str_detect(crash_type_text, "PEDESTRIAN") ~ "Pedestrian",
        str_detect(crash_type_text, "PEDALCYCL|BICYCL") ~ "Bicyclist",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) |>
    filter(collision_mode %in% c("Pedestrian", "Bicyclist")) |>
    mutate(
      # Build the date from the separate year, month, and day fields.
      # Do not infer a time until TimeOfCrash / CrashHour values are verified.
      year = as.integer(CrashYr),
      crash_date = make_date(
        year = year,
        month = as.integer(CrashMonth),
        day = as.integer(CrashDay)
      ),

      # Derive the most serious injury recorded anywhere in the crash.
      # Missing counts are not automatically treated as zero.
      Most_Serious_Injury = case_when(
        TotalFatals > 0 ~ "Fatal Injury",
        AInjuries > 0 ~ "Suspected Serious Injury",
        BInjuries > 0 ~ "Suspected Minor Injury",
        CInjuries > 0 ~ "Possible Injury",
        TotalFatals == 0 & TotalInjured == 0 ~ "No Apparent Injury",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      Most_Serious_Injury = factor(
        Most_Serious_Injury,
        levels = injury_levels
      )
    ) |>
    select(-crash_type_text)

  if (nrow(crashes_prepared) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No pedestrian or bicycle crash types matched. ",
      "Inspect data/IDOT_crashes/evanston_crash_type_audit.csv."
    )
  }

  if (anyNA(crashes_prepared$crash_date)) {
    stop(
      "Some selected crashes have missing or invalid dates. ",
      "Inspect CrashYr, CrashMonth, and CrashDay before continuing."
    )
  }

  evanston_crashes <- crashes_prepared

  # Cache the processed GIS dataset separately from the old geocoding cache.
  saveRDS(
    list(
      version = cache_version,
      sources = source_manifest,
      data = evanston_crashes
    ),
    cache_file
  )
}

# Exclude empty geometries and unknown severity from the map only.
map_crashes <- evanston_crashes |>
  filter(
    !st_is_empty(geometry),
    Most_Serious_Injury != "Unknown"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Most_Serious_Injury = droplevels(Most_Serious_Injury)
  )


if (nrow(map_crashes) == 0L) {
  stop("The selected crashes have no nonempty map geometries.")
}

# Use the supplied geometry to describe the location without reverse geocoding.
coordinates <- st_coordinates(map_crashes)

map_crashes$crash_location <- sprintf(
  "%.5f, %.5f",
  coordinates[, "Y"],
  coordinates[, "X"]
)

data_period <- paste(range(evanston_crashes$year), collapse = "–")

# Use explicit four-digit labels for the map's year controls.
map_crashes <- map_crashes |>
  mutate(year_label = sprintf("%04d", year))

```


### Notes on the data:

- These are crashes that the Illinois Department of Transportation compiles and publishes.
- "Suspected Serious Injury" means something like life-threatening, "Suspected Minor Injury" is for anything not immediately life threatening (including a broken rib or femur).

## Map

Use the controls on the left to filter the crash markers by year, injury severity, and vulnerable user. 

```{r map}

# Create SharedData object for Crosstalk filtering
shared_crashes <- SharedData$new(map_crashes)

# Define color palette matching the original YlOrRd scheme
# Define explicit color mapping
injury_colors <- c(
  "No Apparent Injury"       = "#999999",
  "Possible Injury"          = "#FECC5C",
  "Suspected Minor Injury"    = "#FD8D3C",
  "Suspected Serious Injury"  = "#E31A1C",
  "Fatal Injury"             = "#800026",
  "Unknown"                  = "#756BB1"
)

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = unname(injury_colors),
  domain = injury_levels,
  levels = injury_levels,
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Build a separate legend containing only known injury severities.
map_legend_levels <- injury_levels[injury_levels != "Unknown"]

map_legend <- htmltools::tags$div(
  style = "padding: 10px; font-size: 13px;",
  htmltools::tags$strong("Injury Severity"),
  lapply(map_legend_levels, function(level) {
    htmltools::tags$div(
      style = "display: flex; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px;",
      htmltools::tags$span(
        style = paste0(
          "display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; ",
          "width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-right: 8px; ",
          "border: 1px solid #444444; border-radius: 50%; ",
          "background-color: ", injury_colors[[level]], ";"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::tags$span(level)
    )
  })
)

# Layout filters and map side-by-side
bscols(
  widths = c(3, 9),
  list(
    filter_checkbox("year", "Year", shared_crashes, ~year_label),
    filter_checkbox("injury", "Injury Severity", shared_crashes, ~Most_Serious_Injury, allLevels = TRUE),
    filter_checkbox("type", "Road user type", shared_crashes, ~collision_mode)
  ),
  leaflet(
    shared_crashes,
    width = "100%",
    height = 550,
#    options = leafletOptions(maxZoom = 22)
  ) |>
#    addProviderTiles(
#      "Esri.WorldGrayCanvas",
#      options = providerTileOptions(
#        maxNativeZoom = 16,
#        maxZoom = 22
#      )
#    ) |>
    #addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap.Mapnik") |>
    #addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Stadia.AlidadeSmooth) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      radius = 6,
      fillColor = ~pal(Most_Serious_Injury),
      fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "#444444",
      weight = 1,
      popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>Coordinates:</strong> ", crash_location, "<br/>",
      "<strong>Road user type:</strong> ", collision_mode, "<br/>",
      "<strong>Crash severity:</strong> ", Most_Serious_Injury, "<br/>",
      "<strong>Date:</strong> ", format(crash_date, "%B %d, %Y")
      )
    ),
  map_legend
)
```
      
## Crash Trends over Time

```{r barGraph}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7
#| column: page

# Aggregate crash counts by year, collision type, and injury severity.
crashes_summary <- evanston_crashes |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(collision_mode %in% c("Bicyclist", "Pedestrian")) |>
  filter(Most_Serious_Injury %in% c("Fatal Injury", "Suspected Serious Injury", "Suspected Minor Injury")) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(as.character(year)),
    Most_Serious_Injury = factor(
      Most_Serious_Injury,
      levels = c(
        "Fatal Injury",
        "Suspected Serious Injury",
        "Suspected Minor Injury",
        "Possible Injury",
        "No Apparent Injury"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  count(
    year,
    collision_mode,
    Most_Serious_Injury,
    name = "total"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      "Year: ", sprintf("%04d", year),
      "\nRoad user: ", collision_mode,
      "\nCrash severity: ", Most_Serious_Injury,
      "\nCrashes: ", total
    ),
    bar_id = paste(
      year,
      collision_mode,
      Most_Serious_Injury,
      sep = "-"
    )
  )

# Calculate totals for labels above each annual bar.
annual_totals <- crashes_summary |>
  group_by(year, collision_mode) |>
  summarise(total = sum(total), .groups = "drop")

plot_years <- seq(
  min(crashes_summary$year),
  max(crashes_summary$year)
)

# Compare annual totals while retaining the injury-severity breakdown.
p <- ggplot(
  crashes_summary,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = total,
    fill = Most_Serious_Injury,
    group = Most_Serious_Injury
  )
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = tooltip,
      data_id = bar_id
    ),
    width = 0.75,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = annual_totals,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = total,
      label = total
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = injury_colors,
    name = "Most serious injury in crash",
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = plot_years,
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%04d", as.integer(x))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  # Use the same vertical scale in both panels for direct comparison.
  facet_wrap(
    vars(collision_mode),
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "fixed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Evanston Crashes Involving Pedestrians & Bicyclists",
    subtitle = paste("Annual IDOT crash counts:", data_period),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of crashes",
    caption = paste(
      "Labels show annual totals.",
      "Severity is the most serious injury anywhere in the crash."
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0)
  )

# Render the interactive plot
girafe(
  ggobj = p,
  width_svg = 11,
  height_svg = 7,
  options = list(
#    opts_hover(css = "opacity:0.8;cursor:pointer;"),
#    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.5;"),
#    opts_tooltip(css = "font-size:16px;"),
    opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
  )
)
```


```{js}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() {
    // 1. Check ALL Year checkboxes
    document.querySelectorAll('#year input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
      cb.checked = true;
      cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    });

    // 2. Check ALL Collision Type checkboxes (Bicycle & Pedestrian)
    document.querySelectorAll('#type input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
      cb.checked = true;
      cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
    });
    
    // 3. Check selected Injury Severities
    const targetInjuries = [
     "Suspected Minor Injury",
     "Suspected Serious Injury",
     "Fatal Injury"   
    ];
    document.querySelectorAll('#injury input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(cb) {
    if (targetInjuries.includes(cb.value)) {
    cb.checked = true;
        cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
      }
    });
  }, 300);
});
```
